verdicts.reason: A: clean left-to-right flow with the badge, box, copy and CTA well separated and the headline/body roughly left-aligned, but the lime panel runs flush to the right edge so the CTA has only about 6px of margin, and the body copy is very small at 90px tall. B: the pink 48H badge collides with the box's left edge, the CTA is jammed right up against the end of the headline, and the body text is tiny. B does keep the original's look of a panel sitting on the stripes, but the cramped right cluster and the badge overlap make it the weaker of the two.
